title: Passive calories on Nutrition
highlights: Health → Nutrition now estimates resting burn (BMR) from your body profile, then shows passive, active, total burned, and net calories for the day.
Set sex at birth, date of birth, and height once under Settings → Body & weight. Daily weight still updates the estimate as you log it.

title: Cleaner Health today details
highlights: Steps and sleep Today views no longer list overlapping copies of the same session from your watch and phone.
Sleep charts use the deduped session too, so hourly bars stay within a realistic range instead of stacking duplicate nights.

title: Scan barcodes to log food
highlights: Android app: pick a meal first, then search by name or scan a barcode in the same add-food sheet-no separate scan step or meal picker.
Can't scan? Tap Type barcode instead and enter the UPC digits manually. If FatSecret doesn't have that product, search by name as before.
